opening: HomeAboutWatch it happen, then learn its name.TechConcepts is a free site of short, visual lessons on how technology works. You watch a real process play out one step at a time, then read what it was, in plain words.tracks planned7lessons ready30accounts needed0
what: What TechConcepts isTechConcepts teaches how technology works by showing it. Each lesson plays a real process, such as a laptop asking the network for an address, one step at a time, and explains each step in plain words.The first track, How the Internet Works, is written for anyone starting out, including people studying for entry-level IT certifications. Five more tracks are on the way: CompTIA A+, Cryptography, AI Concepts, Privilege Escalation, and Threat & Vulnerability Management.You don’t need an account, and you can open any lesson in any order.
lessons: How a lesson worksEvery lesson has the same three parts, so you always know where you are.WATCH · STEP 2 OF 41 WatchSee it happenA scene plays the process step by step. Pause it, slow it down, or go back a step whenever you like.LEARN · PLAIN WORDS2 LearnGet the idea, then the nameEach idea starts with an everyday comparison, then gives you the real term. Exam detail waits under Go deeper, closed until you want it.PRACTICE · 3 QUESTIONS3 PracticeCheck yourselfA few questions, just for you. Each answer says why it’s right or not. Nothing is scored or saved.Lessons are self-paced. Take as long as you need. This browser remembers where you stopped, so you can pick up where you left off.The example networks use addresses set aside for documentation and private use, so nothing in a lesson points at a real machine.
